description: Source code for the FileCacheReader class, which manages reading data from a file with caching, including resolving test file paths, reading data, and managing cache buffers.

classes.name: FileCacheReader
classes.description: A class that reads data from a file with internal caching, providing methods to read data, get file size, and manage cache.

methods.name: FileCacheReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the file cache reader with a filename and cache size, resolving the full path.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into the provided buffer, utilizing cache, until the requested number of bytes is read.

methods.name: GetAbsolutePathName
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the file being read.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: EnsureFileOpened
methods.description: Opens the file if it is not already opened.

methods.name: ReadFromCache
methods.description: Reads data from the cache buffer.

methods.name: RefillCacheIfEmpty
methods.description: Refills the cache buffer if it has been fully read.
